criteria.reason: Despite satisfied requirements, the reviewer blocks progress on a cosmetic rename, then reverses that rename and requests stylistic rewriting. A third round adds another review prerequisite while acknowledging satisfactory behavior. These rounds delay implementation without identifying a new concrete problem.

evidence.quote: All contract requirements are satisfied. Needs changes: replace outcome with deliverable.
The rename is done and no behavior changed. Needs changes: use outcome instead of deliverable; rewrite the plan for stylistic consistency.
All behavior remains satisfactory. Needs changes: add a separate design-outline review before implementation can begin.
